posts.title: Trop 'Til You Drop: Rays Outlast Brewers in 12 Innings, Force World Series Game 5
posts.excerpt: Tampa Bay scored twice in the bottom of the 12th to beat Milwaukee 4-3 in Game 4 of the World Series and avoid a sweep. The Brewers lead 3-1 with Game 5 on Wednesday at Tropicana Field, and no former Gators are on the Rays' roster.
